briefdescription.para: Dual secondary index (BM25 + vector) for LLM Wiki chunks.

detaileddescription.para: Provides read/write interfaces over a hybrid retrieval back-end that combines a fulltext (BM25) secondary index from SecondaryIndexManager with a dense vector HNSW index from VectorIndexManager, fused via HybridRetriever. A lightweight JsonWikiIndexReader (Phase A fallback) reads the Python-MVP index.json format and performs in-memory BM25 scoring without a live RocksDB instance.
